text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we work. Automation now handles many repetitive tasks, such as organizing data and answering simple customer questions. Productivity tools powered by AI help employees save time and focus on more important work. Many companies also encourage human-AI collaboration, where people and machines solve problems together. However, these changes affect jobs. Some positions may disappear, while new ones will appear. This means workers need to learn new skills to stay competitive. Overall, AI can make workplaces more efficient, but it also requires people to adapt to a rapidly changing environment.
